# WexaShelf repository instructions

Read and follow the shared contributor instructions in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making changes. Use [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), the [documentation index](../documents/README.md), [AI contribution workflow](../documents/AI-CONTRIBUTION.md), and [testing guide](../documents/TESTING.md) for the agreed process.

Keep changes scoped, preserve other contributors' work, and validate with isolated synthetic data. The primary deployment is PHP/MySQL with a built React interface. Do not expose credentials, invent evidence, trigger hosted CI, push, open pull requests, merge or publish without authorization for the action. Maintainer review is required before acceptance.

Finish development with the contribution handoff in `AGENTS.md`: prepare the reviewed diff, validation results and local PR description; check the actual checkout, history, remotes, fork/base and authentication; then offer the concrete contribution to the computer owner. Honor existing scoped authorization, otherwise await one explicit approval before commit/push/PR publication. Git or login alone is not consent. Missing prerequisites or a declined/unanswered offer leave a local handoff, never background reporting.
